name: Stitch Patterns
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Craft sheets, computed entirely in your browser: cross-stitch with tinted cells and chart symbols, diamond painting with faceted drills, fuse beads with pegboard split lines, bead weaving in peyote, brick stitch or on the loom with Miyuki Delica numbers, a gauge-aware knitting chart that keeps your photo's proportions, C2C crochet, filet crochet with its lace, a latch-hook rug chart with yarn estimates, blackwork with tones stitched as fill patterns, and a patchwork quilt of squares and half-square triangles with its cutting list. Without a picture: hitomezashi stitched from two words, friendship bracelets with a name in knots or a chevron with the knot directions, and the string mandala. Every chart can show the finished piece beside it: crosses of floss on Aida, knitted stitches, crochet blocks, a shaggy rug pile, sparkling drills, ironed beads, woven beads, lace, linen, cloth and knots. The legend names the real thread to buy: the nearest DMC floss for cross-stitch and diamond painting, Hama or Perler for fuse beads, Red Heart for yarn - and the chart is worked in exactly those colors. Knitting charts can follow Fair Isle rules, two colors per row, with floats too long to leave marked in red. The whole pattern comes as a printable PDF: a cover with the finished piece and its size, the chart spread over pages that overlap and count in the whole chart's numbers, and the thread list. String art winds one thread, or several in different colors one after another, around a round, square or heart-shaped board with the same engine as Text Art, stays sharp at any size, tells you how much thread your board takes and comes with a numbered winding guide per color, a nail template at real size to print and a time-lapse video of the winding. The string mandala draws the classic times-table chord patterns. Source: the whole document, any layer or the media library. Yarn colors come from the image, preset palettes, your brand kit or custom colors. Every sheet takes a title in the editor font catalog, with counting grid, edge numbers and a legend with per-color usage. Insert as an editable layer and reopen via Edit Stitch Patterns.
